sql: SELECT h.holiday_date, h.holiday_name, h.is_national FROM whybot.us_holidays h JOIN whybot.yellow_daily y ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 1 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' GROUP BY h.holiday_date, h.holiday_name, h.is_national ORDER BY h.holiday_date LIMIT 500
